items.title: Remove koala CLI alias runtime behavior
items.context: Delete operational compatibility: no koala or koala-codex binary/wrapper path, no @koala-agent/core or node_modules/.bin/koala fallback, and no help/version wording advertising a legacy alias. Keep persisted historical evidence names only where changing them would corrupt existing signed story data.
items.userSees: `lattice --version` prints `Lattice CLI 0.3.5` without `legacy alias: koala`; `lattice help` and command help no longer advertise koala compatibility.

happy.desc: Run node bin/lattice.js --version -> output is exactly the Lattice product line and contains no `legacy alias` or `koala` text.
Run node bin/lattice.js help and node bin/lattice.js story_create --help -> neither output contains `legacy alias`, `Compatible: koala`, or `koala remains a legacy alias`.
Runtime fact registry and doctor scan describe lattice-only global and project-local entrypoints, with no @koala-agent/core or node_modules/.bin/koala fallback text.

edge.desc: If a stale project-local bin/koala.js exists, doctor/runtime checks do not accept it as a valid active wrapper and report it as stale or irrelevant rather than compatibility evidence.
lattice.config.json behavior continues to work; this story does not accidentally remove unrelated project config loading.

adversarial.desc: Search active runtime sources for `legacy alias: koala`, `Compatible: koala`, `@koala-agent/core fallback`, and `node_modules/.bin/koala` -> zero active compatibility hits outside explicitly excluded historical/process text.
Attempting to use the old koala binary path is not part of validation and no test asserts it remains usable.

verificationEvidence.note: Output is exactly Lattice CLI 0.3.5 and contains no legacy alias or koala text.

verificationEvidence.command: node bin/lattice.js help; node bin/lattice.js story_create --help
verificationEvidence.note: Help output contains no legacy alias: koala, Compatible: koala, or koala remains a legacy alias text.
Doctor output and runtime fact contract describe lattice-only active entrypoints and do not advertise @koala-agent/core, node_modules/.bin/koala, bin/koala, or koala.config.json fallback.
Absence smoke plants legacy-only koala assets and confirms runtime/Codex checks do not accept them as active compatibility.
Canonical lattice.config.json remains active, while a legacy-only koala.config.json fixture is not loaded as active config or validation commands.

verificationEvidence.command: targeted active-runtime legacy string scan plus doctor residue check
verificationEvidence.note: Remaining koala hits are negative assertions, historical/path identifiers, env-variable naming debt, or reviewer lane names; active runtime compatibility claims for legacy alias, @koala-agent/core fallback, node_modules/.bin/koala, and koala.config.json fallback are absent.

verificationEvidence.command: test ! -e bin/koala.js && test ! -e bin/koala-codex.js && package script absence check
verificationEvidence.note: Legacy koala executable paths are absent and package scripts no longer expose test:legacy-koala-compatibility-smoke, so validation does not assert the old binary remains usable.

items.title: Update Codex and generated assets to lattice-only wrappers
items.context: Codex adapter assets, managed asset generation, init output, wrapper verification, and docs should use bin/lattice.js and bin/lattice-codex.js only. Remove .Codex/koala.json compatibility acceptance from active checks and templates.
items.userSees: Codex-facing docs and verification output tell the user to run `node bin/lattice-codex.js ...`; legacy `bin/koala-codex.js`, `.Codex/koala.json`, and `.codex/koala.json` are not accepted as active compatibility assets.

happy.desc: Run node bin/lattice-codex.js session_brief -> succeeds and records source=codex/local-wrapper without requiring bin/koala-codex.js.
Run node bin/lattice.js verify_codex -> adapter checks pass using lattice-codex/lattice wrapper paths only.
Codex README and manifest guidance mention bin/lattice-codex.js and bin/lattice.js only for active commands.

edge.desc: Managed asset generation for new projects creates lattice wrappers and does not create bin/koala.js or bin/koala-codex.js compatibility files.
Existing user-owned legacy files are not overwritten by this story unless they are generated compatibility assets in this repo.

adversarial.desc: Plant only legacy .Codex/koala.json or bin/koala-codex.js in a fixture root -> Codex adapter verification fails or ignores it, never counts it as a passing active asset.
rg over active Codex/generated asset docs for `koala-codex` and `.Codex/koala.json` -> zero active compatibility guidance remains outside historical archived notes.

verificationEvidence.note: verify-entrypoints passed 26/26 and thin-init-assets-smoke passed, covering that generated init preserves user-owned legacy files while avoiding regenerated koala compatibility assets.
Local lattice-codex wrapper session_brief passed at current HEAD without requiring bin/koala-codex.js.
Codex adapter verification passed 7/7 using lattice and lattice-codex active paths.
Codex asset verifier passed and checks README, manifest, wrapper resolver, and generated assets for lattice-only active command guidance.
Entrypoint verification passed 26/26 and confirms generated init creates lattice wrappers without bin/koala.js or bin/koala-codex.js compatibility files.
Codex registry mode smoke passed, confirming legacy-only .Codex/koala.json or bin/koala-codex.js fixture paths do not satisfy active Codex adapter verification.
Active Codex/generated asset docs scan produced no koala-codex or .Codex/koala.json guidance hits.

items.title: Replace compatibility smokes with absence assertions
items.context: Tests and verification scripts should assert that koala alias/fallback compatibility is absent rather than preserved. Update package scripts, branding smoke, rollout smoke, runtime fact contract, entrypoint verification, and Codex asset verification accordingly.
items.userSees: The verification suite reports lattice-only branding and absence of koala compatibility; any reintroduced `legacy alias: koala`, koala package fallback, or generated koala wrapper makes the smoke fail.

happy.desc: Run npm --prefix packages/main run build -> all updated TypeScript tasks compile.
Run targeted branding/runtime/codex verification commands -> pass and assert lattice-only entrypoints.
package scripts no longer expose `test:legacy-koala-compatibility-smoke`; replacement or updated tests assert absence of the alias.

edge.desc: The active docs sync smoke expects lattice as sole active product command and does not require koala --version verification.
Tests still allow historical/process identifiers where deliberately excluded, such as reviewer lane names, but not runtime compatibility claims.

adversarial.desc: Introduce `legacy alias: koala` into the product line formatter or README active product paragraph -> targeted smoke fails.
Re-add @koala-agent/core fallback to runtime checks or generated bootstrap -> runtime fact contract / entrypoint verification fails.

verificationEvidence.note: TypeScript build passes after replacing compatibility smoke/task code and runtime/Codex checks.

verificationEvidence.command: node scripts/verify-runtime-fact-contract.mjs; node scripts/verify-entrypoints.mjs; node scripts/verify-codex-assets.mjs
verificationEvidence.note: Targeted runtime, entrypoint, and Codex verifiers pass and assert lattice-only active paths.
packages/main/package.json no longer exposes test:legacy-koala-compatibility-smoke and includes test:lattice-only-absence-smoke.
Docs/runtime generated text checks enforce lattice as sole active product command and reject legacy alias wording.
Historical process identifiers and reviewer lane names remain, while active compatibility claims are removed or covered only by negative assertions.
Reintroducing @koala-agent/core fallback or generated koala wrapper text is covered by the updated contract and entrypoint verifiers.
The lattice-only absence smoke asserts generated product lines, README/template text, and compatibility fixtures fail if legacy alias: koala or generated koala wrapper compatibility returns.
